coverageMeaning: A covered target has a planned or approved authored 2048x2048 seamless albedo plus packed tangent-normal/roughness material pair with explicit texel scale, consumers, shared anisotropy and residency budgets, approved concept-reference gates, seam proof, and real mobile capture requirements. Planned coverage is not runtime art.

consumerAudit.finding: Authoritative four themes, four planets, 16 named regions, and 48 size-specific battlefields. Theme Vespera Dusk is distinct from planet Vespera; runtime faction aliases legion/horde correspond to public Dominion/Brood content-library families.

Loads atomic albedo and packed normal/roughness sets, selects location surfaces from map/region identity, and applies tint/profile slots. All vespera_* regions force the Vespera crust even when their map theme is Ashland or Verdant.
Quality-tier ground shader samples authored material sheets with derivative-aware detail, location tint, and the shared terrain texture set.
Instanced city towers, domes, halls, tanks, and civic blocks consume shared base/AO, normal-roughness-emissive, masks, damage, and detail inputs under a mobile battle LOD.
Planetary civic, industrial, outpost, ruin, and faction-contact placements reuse authored world-kit geometry across the real map catalogue.

Binds the active terrain profile/tints and renders neutral cities, world-kit sites, and faction-owned structures through distinct paths. This is the device-visible consumer that matched mobile captures must exercise.

Player-faction semantic material IDs currently resolve through one shared 11x11 building atlas with architecture, faction-signature, biome-detail, damage, and world-kit ranges; semantic pack records do not yet point to standalone texture files.
Authoritative NEXUS-VII district IDs and deck roles: command, navigation, survey, mission_ops, research, fabricator, engineering, habitat, factions, hangar, and logistics.

Loads only the authored command-cutaway GLB for the interior, clones embedded PBR textures/materials, and preserves map, normal, roughness, emissive, and material identity per scene instance; loose authoring PNG changes are not visible until the GLB is rebuilt.
Binds authored DISTRICT_* roots to district_id metadata, preserves authored PBR identities, and focuses one real compartment without blanket hull-material replacement.

Authoring bridge that embeds texture inputs into uga-command-cutaway.glb. Canonical PBR families are uga-command-navigation, uga-operations, uga-science, uga-industrial, uga-civic-medical, and uga-diplomatic, with deck floor, pressure wall, transit, glazing, and exterior hull kept as distinct roles.

The optional runtime pack includes uga-command-cutaway.glb but not loose UGA source textures, so authoring material changes require a deterministic GLB rebuild and repack before device captures can prove them.

targets.label: Verdant base terrain
targets.rationale: Base living-ground, soil/rock, and controlled paving language used wherever MAPDEFS resolves to Verdant.

targets.label: Arctic base terrain
targets.rationale: Base snow/ice, fractured rock, and cold hardscape language used wherever MAPDEFS resolves to Arctic.

targets.label: Ashland base terrain
targets.rationale: Base ash, basalt, and heat-weathered hardscape language used wherever MAPDEFS resolves to Ashland.

targets.label: Vespera dusk base terrain
targets.rationale: Base mineral-organic dusk terrain and restrained alien hardscape language for the standalone Vespera theme.

targets.label: Aelos Capital Circumference
targets.rationale: Intact capital avenues, parade yards, and supplied civic-grid terrain need a location accent distinct from generic grass.

targets.label: Aelos Heartland Yards
targets.rationale: Maintained parkland, river quays, factory terraces, and garden-city contact require their own ground accent.

targets.label: Aelos Harbor Command
targets.rationale: Working seawalls, naval yards, causeways, salt-weathered concrete, and dry harbor approaches need a coastal accent.

targets.label: Aelos High Shelf
targets.rationale: Nova garrison stone under an authored sibling-Arctic theme needs cold retaining-wall and high-shelf contact rather than Nordhall automation language.

targets.label: Pyraeth Buried Court
targets.rationale: Buried domes, crater bowls, foundry lanes, and the large-map Ashland override need one Dominion-compatible impact contact family.

targets.label: Pyraeth Mech Foundry
targets.rationale: Assembly trenches, armor terraces, and the Promethean grid need a heavy industrial ground-contact accent.

targets.label: Pyraeth Dome Arcology
targets.rationale: Pressure-dome cities, heat bridges, and storm-cut rims need a vitrified arcology-contact accent.

targets.label: Pyraeth Orbital Aprons
targets.rationale: Landing causeways, exposed pads, buried logistics, and blackwind abrasion need an orbital-apron accent.

targets.label: Nordhall Frostwake Grid
targets.rationale: Ice bridges, automated naval yards, drone rails, and frozen-sea factories need an automation-contact accent.

targets.label: Nordhall Frontline Shelf
targets.rationale: Artillery-scarred shelves, frozen ravines, machine terraces, and command canyon contact need a scarred ice-concrete accent.

targets.label: Nordhall Reactor Rift
targets.rationale: Cracking shelves, buried reactors, fault bridges, and thermal wells need a stressed glacial-industrial accent.

targets.label: Nordhall Orbital Weather
targets.rationale: Meteor-weathered automation spurs, radar ruins, saddles, and plateaus need a windswept high-altitude accent.

targets.label: Vespera Caldera Nests
targets.rationale: Calderas, spore vents, magma approaches, and hive-spire infestation need a non-humanoid hostile ecology contact accent; the selector forces Vespera crust beneath its Ashland theme.

targets.label: Vespera Infestation Fields
targets.rationale: Ichor passages, buried causeways, hive carpets, and branching nest canyons need an infestation-field accent over the forced Vespera crust.

targets.label: Vespera Magma Hatcheries
targets.rationale: Swallowed factories, fractured logistics, magma crypts, and nest-converted industrial ground need a derelict infestation accent over the forced Vespera crust.

targets.label: Vespera Overgrown Front
targets.rationale: Overgrown highland, eroded fortifications, biomass, and the large-map Ashland transition need a dual-theme hostile ecology accent while all sizes retain Vespera crust selection.

targets.label: Faction-neutral planetary civic architecture
targets.rationale: Shared civilian towers, domes, halls, blocks, ruins, and foundations need neutral materials that accept biome contact without copying a player faction.

targets.label: Nova architecture contact variants
targets.rationale: Nova brutalist civic and production surfaces need authored weather/contact variants across all battlefield themes.

targets.label: Dominion architecture contact variants
targets.rationale: Dominion foundry, dome, and fortified architecture needs authored surface/contact variants across all battlefield themes.

targets.label: Syndicate architecture contact variants
targets.rationale: Syndicate automation, stealth, and logistics architecture needs authored surface/contact variants across all battlefield themes.

targets.label: Brood hostile architecture and infestation contact
targets.rationale: Non-humanoid hostile hives, tunnels, infestations, and consumed structures need authored biome-contact variants without implying civic residency.

targets.label: NEXUS-VII Command, Navigation, and Mission Operations
targets.rationale: Requested production group spans two current PBR families: command/navigation use uga-command-navigation while mission_ops uses uga-operations; shared floor/wall/machinery roles must remain distinct from both.

targets.label: NEXUS-VII Survey and Research
targets.rationale: Survey and research share the current uga-science PBR family across Decks A and B; role-separated science surfaces must stay distinct from exterior hull metal.

targets.label: NEXUS-VII Fabrication and Engineering
targets.rationale: Fabricator and engineering share the current uga-industrial PBR family; forge floors, service bulkheads, reactors, and machinery still require separate authored roles.

targets.label: NEXUS-VII Habitat and Coalition Embassy
targets.rationale: Requested production group intentionally spans uga-civic-medical for habitat and uga-diplomatic for factions; shared floors/walls must preserve warmer civil identity without flattening both into one material.

targets.label: NEXUS-VII Strike Bay and Logistics
targets.rationale: Hangar and logistics share uga-operations with mission_ops but span function and civil sectors; durable lanes, racks, and cargo contact must remain readable and exclude Brood roster language.
